title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation derived on read: the honorific 'title' and the
                lastName joined by a single space when a title is present, otherwise
                just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, assigned on create and formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from the
                postcode (or 'UNKNOWN'), FY the two-digit fiscal year of the
                (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate (see fiscalYear), HASH8 the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized (E.164)
                telephone concatenated with lastName, and CHK a single Luhn check digit over
                the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. When the computed id collides with an
                existing owner's, a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW27A1B2C3D40'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate in July-December
                falls in the fiscal year ending the following calendar year; YY is the last two
                digits of that ending year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is present,
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, add 3 for
                tenure over one fiscal year (elapsed 1-July fiscal years since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-4), derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) - approaching the hard capacity limit of
                50 owners per city. Assigned on create; false otherwise. A create is rejected
                with 409 only once the city holds 50 or more.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment derived on read, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived on read from the owner's locality/region using
                a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the telephone is in
                E.164 form, the email is lower-cased (empty when absent), and householdId is
                the owner's shared-household identifier (empty when not in a shared
                household). A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived on read from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64 and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner shared the
                same lastName (compared case-insensitively) and postcode while not being a
                hard duplicate (differing identityKey, e.g. a different telephone). Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (see
                'possibleDuplicate'). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single review signal derived on read: true when ANY of the following

                ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it is not itself an outright-blocked disposable
                domain, but shares a base label with one - e.g. a different TLD such as

                blocked set mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com); or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner flags this
                true and retains the record; a newly created owner is false. Owners flagged
                deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the

              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

# Owner Identity Feature — Exploration Report

This is a Spring PetClinic variant with a dual-arm architecture (Spring + OfficeFloor function classes). The "owner identity" feature is implemented as a set of pure-function derivation helpers plus OfficeFloor "Assign*" service functions, surfaced through a MapStruct `OwnerMapper` into `OwnerDto`.

## Key finding: a v2 identity contract is expected by tests but NOT yet implemented

The single acceptance test (`AcceptanceTest.java`) expects a **v2 response shape** that the production code does not currently produce:
- expects top-level `apiVersion == 2` — no code sets `apiVersion` anywhere.
- expects `memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId` nested under an `identity` object, and NOT at the top level.
- The current `OwnerMapper` / `openapi.yml` emit these **flat** at the top level, and `memberId`/`householdId` aren't even mapped in `OwnerMapper` (only `identityKey`, `locality`, `timezone`, `ownerSegment` are). So this feature appears to be the thing to build.

There is also a **spec/impl mismatch on `identityKey`**: `openapi.yml` (lines 2286-2297) documents it as `normalizedTelephone|email|householdId`, but `IdentityKeys.java` actually computes SHA-256 of `normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)`.

---

## 1. Owner identity derivation

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/MemberIds.java
Central `memberId` derivation `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, plus `localityOf`, `timezoneOf`, `region`.
- `region(postcode)` → `Localities.forPostcode`, else `"UNKNOWN"`.
- `forOwner`: `region + fy + hash8(owner)` then `+ CheckDigits.luhn(base)`. `fy` = `String.format("%02d", FiscalYears.yearSegment(...))` or `"00"`.
- `hash8` = first 8 upper-case hex of SHA-256 of `(E164 telephone + lastName)`.
- `localityOf` = `region(owner.getPostcode())`; `timezoneOf` = `Localities.timezoneForRegion(localityOf(owner))`.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/IdentityKeys.java
The `identityKey` used for duplicate detection.
- `build(tel,email,lastName)` = `Digests.sha256Hex( E164(tel) + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + Soundex.encode(lastName) )`.
- `forOwner(Owner)` and `forFields(tel,email,lastName)` entry points.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Households.java
`householdId` derivation.
- `idFor(lastName, postcode)` = `hash(normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode)`.
- `hash` = 12-char upper-case prefix of SHA-256.
- `normalize` = trim, collapse whitespace, lower-case.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/Localities.java
Region resolution.
- `CITY_REGION`: Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD.
- `REGION_RANGE`: NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099.
- `REGION_TIMEZONE`: NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane.
- Methods: `timezoneForRegion`, `forCity` (default `"UNKNOWN"`), `forPostcode` (range lookup, null when unresolved), `forCityAndPostcode` (postcode preferred, city fallback).

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Postcodes.java
Postcode validation against city region (same NSW/VIC/QLD ranges); blank OK, must be 4 digits.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Soundex.java
American Soundex encoding (letter + 3 digits, `"0000"` fallback) — last-name component of identityKey and phonetic axis of soft-match.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Digests.java
`sha256Hex(value)` — full lower-case hex SHA-256; single hashing primitive used by Households, MemberIds, IdentityKeys.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/CheckDigits.java
`luhn(value)` — single Luhn check digit over embedded digits (the `CHK` segment).

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/FiscalYears.java
FY logic (starts 1 July). `fiscalYear`, `yearSegment` (`%100`), `label` (`FY<YY>`).

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Telephones.java
E.164 normalization (`toE164`) and human display (`toDisplay`). AU `+61`=9 national digits, `+1`=10.

### Assign* service functions (OfficeFloor `service(@Val Owner ...)`)
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignMemberId.java** — sets `memberId` from `MemberIds.forOwner`; appends `-<n>` on collision.
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignHousehold.java** — sets `householdId` = `Households.idFor(lastName, postcode)`.
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignHouseholdSize.java** — counts owners sharing `householdId` (+1 for the new owner).
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignMembershipLevelCap.java** — cap = max household member level + 1.
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignPossibleDuplicate.java** — soft-match flag: same `soundex(lastName)` + postcode but different identityKey; `sharesHousehold` bypasses.
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignNamesakeCount.java** — count of existing owners with same first+last name (case-insensitive).
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RequireUniqueIdentity.java** — rejects (409 `DuplicateIdentityException`) when `IdentityKeys.forFields` matches an existing non-deleted owner; `sharesHousehold` bypasses.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java
JPA entity. Identity-related columns/getters: `memberId` (`member_id`), `householdId` (`household_id`), `namesakeCount`, `householdSize`, `membershipLevelCap`, `possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`, `postcode`, `registrationDate`, `birthDate`, `deleted`, `bulkSignupWarning`, `capacityWarning`. (No `apiVersion`/`identityKey` field — those are derived.)

Related exceptions: **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../rest/escalation/DuplicateIdentityException.java** and **DuplicateIdentityExceptionHandler.java** (returns 409). Doc-comment on the exception states identityKey = `SHA-256 of normalizedTelephone + lowerEmail + soundex(lastName)`.

---

## 2. Owner response DTO / shape

The response DTO is `OwnerDto`, generated from **/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml** (`Owner` schema at lines 2112-2359, extends `OwnerFields` at 1991-2111). Mapping is done in:

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java
MapStruct interface. Derived fields mapped via `expression=`:
- `displayName`, `salutation`, `initials`, `fiscalYear` (`FiscalYears.label`), `membershipPoints`/`membershipLevel` (`MembershipLevels`), `locality` (`MemberIds.localityOf`), `ownerSegment` (`OwnerSegments.forOwner`), `timezone` (`MemberIds.timezoneOf`), `bulkSignupWarning`, `capacityWarning`, `possibleDuplicate`, `riskFlag`, `contactPreference`, `identityKey` (`IdentityKeys.forOwner`), `ageBand` (`AgeBands.forOwner`), `telephoneDisplay`, `deleted`, `selfLink`.
- NOTE: `memberId` and `householdId` are stored on the entity but are NOT explicitly mapped here (rely on MapStruct auto-mapping to the flat DTO). `apiVersion` and a nested `identity` object do not exist in this mapper or in `openapi.yml`.
- `toOwnerPageDto(Page<Owner>)` builds `OwnerPageDto`.

Response emitters:
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RespondWithOwner.java** — `GET` single owner → `toOwnerDto`.
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RespondWithOwnerCreated.java** — `POST` → 201 Created with Location `/api/owners/{id}`.
- **RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java**, **ListOwnersPage.java**, **ListOwners.java** (paged/list variants, in same dir).
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/BuildOwner.java** — builds the entity from `OwnerFieldsDto`, defaults + business-day-adjusts `registrationDate`.

openapi.yml relevant field docs: `memberId` (2163-2176), `householdId` (2187-2195), `locality` (2248-2256), `ownerSegment` (2257-2267), `timezone` (2268-2277), `identityKey` (2286-2297, note mismatch above), `ageBand`, `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf`, `riskFlag`. Input `sharesHousehold` (write-only) at OwnerFields lines 2101-2106.

---

## 3. Audit event / schema version / owner segment

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java
Emits audit records to the `"AUDIT"` SLF4J logger. Emits a human line plus a structured JSON event:
```java
ObjectNode event = JSON.createObjectNode();
event.put("seq", SEQ.incrementAndGet());      // process-wide AtomicLong
event.put("ownerId", owner.getId());
event.put("memberId", primaryIdentifier(owner));  // = owner.getMemberId()
event.put("membershipLevel", membershipLevel);
event.put("event", "OWNER_CREATED");
```
There is **no `schemaVersion`** field in the audit event currently (worth noting if the feature calls for one).

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerSegments.java
`ownerSegment` = `<TIER>_<AREA>`. TIER=`PREMIUM` when `MembershipLevels.forOwner >= 3` else `STANDARD`; AREA=`METRO` when locality ∈ {NSW,VIC,QLD} else `REGIONAL`.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/MembershipLevels.java
`pointsForOwner` and `forOwner` (level 1-4, capped by `membershipLevelCap`). Feeds `ownerSegment`.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/AgeBands.java
`ageBand`: MINOR/ADULT/SENIOR by years between birthDate and registrationDate.

No file defines any `schemaVersion` constant anywhere in src.

---

## 4. Tests

Only three test files exist (all under `src/test/java/.../acceptance/`):

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java
The load-bearing contract for the feature:
```java
/** identity-v2: apiVersion is 2, the memberId/identityKey/householdId are grouped under a nested
 * 'identity' object, and those three are no longer at the top level. Exact structural contract. */
@Test
void coreV2GroupsIdentityAndVersions() throws Exception {
    int id = createOwnerOk(structuredOwner());
    getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.apiVersion").value(2))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identity.memberId").isNotEmpty())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identity.identityKey").isNotEmpty())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identity.householdId").isNotEmpty())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.memberId").doesNotExist())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identityKey").doesNotExist())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.householdId").doesNotExist());
}
```

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java
Black-box base (`POST /api/owners`, `GET /api/owners/{id}`). Contains pinned reference tables (`CITY_REGION`, `REGION_TIMEZONE`, `REGION_POSTCODES`), helpers (`region`, `timezone`, `validPostcode`, `knownOwner`, `structuredOwner`, `withPostcode`), and replicated algorithms `sha256hex`, `shaHex`, `luhn`, `toBusinessDay`. `structuredOwner()` (used by the v2 test) uses `addressLine1` + `postcode "2000"`.

### /home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java
Test utility that attaches a Logback `ListAppender` to the `"AUDIT"` logger; `anyContains`, `anyAtLevel`, `count`, `messages`.

---

## 5. Version handling

- **AcceptanceTest.java** — the only Java reference: expects `apiVersion == 2` (see §4). No production code sets `apiVersion`.
- **/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml** — `info.version: '1.0'` (line 8); tags `owner-v2` / `pet-v2` (lines 16-23); v2 paths `/v2/owners` (line 139) and `/v2/pets` (line 872). The many "An ID for this version of the response" hits are boilerplate `X-Request-Id`-style response headers, not the feature.
- **OfficeFloor v2 route configs**:
  - /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/v2/owners.GET.yml → routes to `ListOwnersPage`.
  - /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/v2/pets.GET.yml.
- The non-v2 single-owner GET route: /home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml → `LoadOwner` + `RespondWithOwner`.

No `apiVersion` or `schemaVersion` field currently exists in the entity, DTO mapper, openapi `Owner` schema, or audit event — implementing the v2 nested-identity contract (and likely an audit `schemaVersion`) is what the test at §4 is driving toward.

---

## Directory structure

### src/main
```
src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/
  PetClinicApplication.java
  config/            SwaggerConfig.java
  mapper/            OwnerMapper, OwnerSegments, Localities, AgeBands, CheckDigits,
                     MembershipLevels, UserMapper, PetTypeMapper, VisitMapper, PetMapper,
                     VetMapper, SpecialtyMapper
  model/             Owner, Person, Pet, PetType, Vet, Visit, User, Role, NamedEntity,
                     BaseEntity, Specialty, package-info
  repository/        OwnerRepository (+ Pet/PetType/Specialty/Vet/Visit/User) 
                     jdbc/  jpa/  springdatajpa/   (impls per store)
  rest/
    escalation/      DuplicateIdentityException(+Handler), CityAtCapacityException,
                     DailyLimitExceededException, FutureRegistrationDateException,
                     RequiredFieldsException, NotFoundException, ProblemDetails,
                     ValidationErrorsResponse, GeneralExceptionHandler, ... (+handlers)
    validation/      PetAgeValidator, PetAgeValidation
    function/
      common/        Lookups, RespondWithNoContent
      owner/         MemberIds, IdentityKeys, Households, Postcodes, Soundex, Digests,
                     Telephones, AddressNormalizer, DisposableDomains, IdempotencyStore,
                     Assign{MemberId,Household,HouseholdSize,MembershipLevelCap,
                     NamesakeCount,PossibleDuplicate,BulkSignupWarning,CapacityWarning},
                     Audit​OwnerCreated, BuildOwner, BuildOwnersPet, ApplyOwner, ValidateOwner,
                     Require{OwnerFields,UniqueIdentity,CityCapacity,DailyLimit,
                     NotFutureRegistrationDate}, Check/Record/RecordIdempotencyKey,
                     EnqueueWelcomeNotification, List/ListPage/Load/Delete/Save/Respond* owner
      pet/ pettype/ specialty/ vet/ visit/ user/ root/
  security/          BasicAuthenticationConfig, DisableSecurityConfig, Roles
  util/              BusinessDays, EntityUtils, FiscalYears

src/main/resources/
  openapi.yml, application*.properties, logback.xml
  db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/{schema.sql,data.sql}
  messages/messages*.properties
  officefloor/rest/api/{owners,pets,pettypes,specialties,vets,visits}/...
  officefloor/rest/api/v2/{owners.GET.yml, pets.GET.yml}
  officefloor/escalation/*.yml
```

### src/test
```
src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/
  AcceptanceBase.java
  AcceptanceTest.java
  AuditLogCapture.java
src/test/resources/application.properties
```

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. One of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned as the composed, normalized
            address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of a structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; an owner is valid
            when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or
            the flat 'address'), plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of a structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When omitted on create, it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address (e.g. a spouse or family member at the same address).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation derived on read: the honorific 'title' and the
                lastName joined by a single space when a title is present, otherwise
                just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, assigned on create and formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from the
                postcode (or 'UNKNOWN'), FY the two-digit fiscal year of the
                (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate (see fiscalYear), HASH8 the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized (E.164)
                telephone concatenated with lastName, and CHK a single Luhn check digit over
                the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. When the computed id collides with an
                existing owner's, a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW27A1B2C3D40'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate in July-December
                falls in the fiscal year ending the following calendar year; YY is the last two
                digits of that ending year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is present,
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, add 3 for
                tenure over one fiscal year (elapsed 1-July fiscal years since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-4), derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) - approaching the hard capacity limit of
                50 owners per city. Assigned on create; false otherwise. A create is rejected
                with 409 only once the city holds 50 or more.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment derived on read, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived on read from the owner's locality/region using
                a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the telephone is in
                E.164 form, the email is lower-cased (empty when absent), and householdId is
                the owner's shared-household identifier (empty when not in a shared
                household). A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived on read from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64 and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner shared the
                same lastName (compared case-insensitively) and postcode while not being a
                hard duplicate (differing identityKey, e.g. a different telephone). Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (see
                'possibleDuplicate'). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single review signal derived on read: true when ANY of the following
                hold, false otherwise - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it is not itself an outright-blocked disposable
                domain, but shares a base label with one - e.g. a different TLD such as
                'mailinator.net', or a subdomain such as 'mail.mailinator.com' - for the
                blocked set mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com); or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner flags this
                true and retains the record; a newly created owner is false. Owners flagged
                deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. One of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned as the composed, normalized
            address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of a structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; an owner is valid
            when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or
            the flat 'address'), plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of a structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When omitted on create, it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address (e.g. a spouse or family member at the same address).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation derived on read: the honorific 'title' and the
                lastName joined by a single space when a title is present, otherwise
                just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response schema. Always 2: the identity
                identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are grouped under the
                'identity' object and derived with the version-2 identity algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate in July-December
                falls in the fiscal year ending the following calendar year; YY is the last two
                digits of that ending year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is present,
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, add 3 for
                tenure over one fiscal year (elapsed 1-July fiscal years since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-4), derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) - approaching the hard capacity limit of
                50 owners per city. Assigned on create; false otherwise. A create is rejected
                with 409 only once the city holds 50 or more.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment derived on read, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived on read from the owner's locality/region using
                a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the telephone is in
                E.164 form, the email is lower-cased (empty when absent), and householdId is
                the owner's shared-household identifier (empty when not in a shared
                household). A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived on read from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64 and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner shared the
                same lastName (compared case-insensitively) and postcode while not being a
                hard duplicate (differing identityKey, e.g. a different telephone). Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (see
                'possibleDuplicate'). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single review signal derived on read: true when ANY of the following
                hold, false otherwise - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it is not itself an outright-blocked disposable
                domain, but shares a base label with one - e.g. a different TLD such as
                'mailinator.net', or a subdomain such as 'mail.mailinator.com' - for the
                blocked set mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com); or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner flags this
                true and retains the record; a newly created owner is false. Owners flagged
                deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

        page:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2

        - content

    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:

          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.

          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string

          title: Birth date

              title: Owner ID

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
