components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. One of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned as the composed, normalized
            address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of a structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; an owner is valid
            when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or
            the flat 'address'), plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of a structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When omitted on create, it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address (e.g. a spouse or family member at the same address).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation derived on read: the honorific 'title' and the
                lastName joined by a single space when a title is present, otherwise
                just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response schema. Always 2: the identity
                identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are grouped under the
                'identity' object and derived with the version-2 identity algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate in July-December
                falls in the fiscal year ending the following calendar year; YY is the last two
                digits of that ending year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is present,
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, add 3 for
                tenure over one fiscal year (elapsed 1-July fiscal years since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-4), derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) - approaching the hard capacity limit of
                50 owners per city. Assigned on create; false otherwise. A create is rejected
                with 409 only once the city holds 50 or more.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment derived on read, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived on read from the owner's locality/region using
                a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the telephone is in
                E.164 form, the email is lower-cased (empty when absent), and householdId is
                the owner's shared-household identifier (empty when not in a shared
                household). A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived on read from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64 and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate

input.new_string:
OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's derived identifiers, grouped together in the version-2 response.
        Every identifier is derived with the version-2 identity algorithm, which mixes
        in a fixed 'V2' version tag so that no value produced under version 1 recurs.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, assigned on create and formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the version-2 region code derived from
            the postcode: the fixed 'V2' version tag followed by the plain region code
            (or 'V2UNKNOWN'). FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted)
            registrationDate (see fiscalYear), HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex characters
            of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with
            lastName, and CHK a single Luhn check digit over the digits of
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. When the computed id collides with an existing owner's,
            a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is appended.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW27A1B2C3D45'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The single derived value all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
            SHA-256 hex digest over the fixed 'V2' version tag, the normalized (E.164)
            telephone, the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and the Soundex code of
            the last name. A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
            identityKey equals an existing owner's.
          type: string
          example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable identifier shared by owners with the same last name and postcode,
            derived with the version-2 algorithm: a 12-hex-character upper-case prefix of
            the SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' version tag, the normalized last name and the
            postcode.
          type: string
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. One of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned as the composed, normalized
            address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of a structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; an owner is valid
            when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or
            the flat 'address'), plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of a structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When omitted on create, it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address (e.g. a spouse or family member at the same address).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation derived on read: the honorific 'title' and the
                lastName joined by a single space when a title is present, otherwise
                just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response schema. Always 2: the identity
                identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are grouped under the
                'identity' object and derived with the version-2 identity algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate in July-December
                falls in the fiscal year ending the following calendar year; YY is the last two
                digits of that ending year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is present,
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, add 3 for
                tenure over one fiscal year (elapsed 1-July fiscal years since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-4), derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) - approaching the hard capacity limit of
                50 owners per city. Assigned on create; false otherwise. A create is rejected
                with 409 only once the city holds 50 or more.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment derived on read, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived on read from the owner's locality/region using
                a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived on read from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64 and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner shared the
                same lastName (compared case-insensitively) and postcode while not being a
                hard duplicate (differing identityKey, e.g. a different telephone). Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (see
                'possibleDuplicate'). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single review signal derived on read: true when ANY of the following
                hold, false otherwise - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it is not itself an outright-blocked disposable
                domain, but shares a base label with one - e.g. a different TLD such as
                'mailinator.net', or a subdomain such as 'mail.mailinator.com' - for the
                blocked set mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com); or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner flags this
                true and retains the record; a newly created owner is false. Owners flagged
                deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
